quotes.text: :func:`datasets.fetch_file` now raises a `ValueError` when `local_filename` is a path instead of a plain filename.
The check happens before any download and nothing is written to disk.

summary: `fetch_file` downloads a file into a folder, and `local_filename` lets you choose the saved file's name. Before the fix it accepted values like `"../escaped.jsonl"` or `"/absolute/data.jsonl"`, so the file could end up outside the folder you chose. The fix accepts only a plain file name and raises a `ValueError` otherwise, before anything is downloaded.
teaches: Treating file names as untrusted input
title: fetch_file and file names that are really paths

whereToLook.hint: Where `local_filename` is chosen, before the folder is created.
